note: Developmental ordering for art direction and review; not an age-rating system.

1.name: First words
1.description: A single familiar referent rendered with enough clear sumi-e gestures for immediate toddler recognition.

2.name: Naturalist referents
2.description: A specific animal, plant, food, tool, or place with enough anatomy to identify it.

3.name: Emotions and relationships
3.description: An expressive face, body state, gesture, or relationship shown through posture and brush movement.

4.name: Scenes and ideas
4.description: A multi-part scene, social role, cultural reference, system, or abstract idea.

literacy_track.name: Literacy symbols
literacy_track.description: Alphabetic, numeric, and punctuation glyphs; ranked separately from image vocabulary.
